summary: On current main bb9c496ed the B&W2 demo runs boot -> Land3 intro -> post-intro 'Click on the Gold Scroll' objective (frames/frame-5703.png) with 0 failed render commands over 8000 s and no crash/unimplemented API. Player camera control: wheel -360 zooms the view out, attributed cleanly (no-input control frames/frame-5703 -> camera/w0 over 3+ min: 1.09% of land pixels differ; w0 -> w1 across the wheel: 28.8%; camera/land-diff.txt). Middle and left drags also move the view (m0->m1 21.1%, l0->l1 24.8%), but after the first input the view keeps moving with no input (idle0->idle1 22.6%, c0->c1 22.0%), so per-drag attribution is NOT isolated. World interaction works: clicks selected the Storehouse (camera/s2.png: Food/Wood/Ore desire, stock panel) and the Field (camera/u1.png: Field info, Productivity 162, villagers walking). The Gold Scroll itself was NOT consumed (two clicks landed on the storehouse/field as the view drifted; objective still shown at 8000 s), so the Field tutorial and later free play are not reached in this run. Scene-qualified frame measurement (presents.ndjson = [runSeconds, PRESENT submitted, PRESENT completed, DRAW submitted, failed] every 5 s from the probe's command-stream counters): Gold Scroll objective, fixed view, no input, 5709-5894 s: 27 presents / 185 s = 0.146 fps, ~641 draws/present, 0 failed. Other windows: flyover 901-1497 s 0.171 fps (617 draws/present); intro village 3000-3596 s 0.128 fps (740); intro Town Center 4903-5598 s 0.131 fps (633). The render worker thread is CPU-saturated (75 min CPU in 82 min wall). Retained failures: an earlier harness (HTTP --control with ctl png/eval and faster boot gaps, captures every 120 s) latched 'D3D9 software: native raster execution failed (-1)' at ~787 s on BOTH bb9c496ed and 0304a8549 (failures/*.json; replaying the captured draw standalone, with or without its real attachments, draws cleanly), so the trigger is harness/timing-dependent and open.
